messages.subject: Project Falcon - Financial & Tax DD report
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus,

Please find attached our financial and tax due diligence report on Penrose Robotics. Headlines: FY2025 revenue £9.8m (recurring software £3.4m), net cash £2.1m pre-raise, drawn venture loan £1.2m, and an FY2025 R&D tax credit of £0.42m not yet received. No fundamental issues; see section 4 for the adjustments to note.

Happy to discuss.

Duncan Reeves
Marlow Tax & Advisory Ltd
